apply: AFTER the coast world is fully built (Xc carve+mirror+dress, applyAshenPatch, applyExitsPatch, NPCs, quests, spawns). Idempotent: world.coastV3 marker.

offset.why: oy=0 keeps the Martsirt exit on the N edge. ox=24 puts 24 m of new land/sea W of the old map (new W sea + bays where the old W water strip meets it) and 24 m E (new road to the bastion exit on the new E edge). New S band y112-179 ends in the S sea.

encoding.rows: H strings of W chars, row y, char x. Base-36 tile id: 0 Grass,1 Grass2,2 Dirt,3 Sand,4 Sand2,5 Stone,6 Road,7 Plaza,8 Water,9 Bridge,a Plank,b Wall,c Cave,d Rug,e Blood. '.' = KEEP the old tile copied from old (x-ox,y-oy). Only appears inside the old rect.
encoding.solid_rows: same layout, '0' walkable, '1' solid, '.' keep old solid
encoding.overrides: Any non-'.' char inside old_rect is an override and is written over the copied old tile.

north_entrance.desc: Old N water block (Water x0-7 y0..~17) and Sand/Sand2/Stone in the north ~16 m converted to Grass/Grass2/Dirt with a noisy (non-straight) south edge. Roads, Plaza, Dirt and Bridge kept.

overrides.west_east_blend: No old tiles changed: every old W/E/S water tile on the old rect border is continued by new Water in a noisy blob (W: 9-18 m, merges with the new W sea; E: 3-8 m lagoon; S: 3-9 m), so there is no straight seam.

exits.rule: offset only; live exit x is 12.5 if exits_v2_coast is live (tile dump: road x10-13 at y0), else 20.2 -> 44.2. Apply x+ox to whatever is live.
MOVED to the new E edge at t=0.45 (P4). sx,sy (arrival in Bastion) unchanged.

martsirt.arrive_coast: Martsirt arrive.coast (martsirt_world.json) is the spot IN MARTSIRT; it is unchanged by this recipe ([53.8,150.9] per the bundle). What must change is the Martsirt->coast exit arrival in the coast: sx,sy = (12.5+ox, 4.0) = [36.5, 4.0] (was [12.5,4.0]); if the live coast town exit is still at x 20.2 use [44.2, 4.2].

bastion.note: Bastion's exit {to:'coast'} sx,sy must be set to [87.4,81.0] (was [37.4,14.2]); move the BASTION arch prop from (40.4+ox,14.2) to the new exit.

road.note: Road tiles (6) are already in tiles[]; polylines are for minimap/AI hints only. East road starts at the old road end (old x41,y13-15).

plateau_note: Plateau rim tiles are solid Dirt dressed with shore rocks; height_m is optional (raise ground inside the rim if cheap, else flat).
spawn_kinds_source: Xc in the bundle: fu(e,t,7,[zombie,zombie,corpse,imp],...), qc(...,[zombie,corpse,imp])

pois.name: Parish wells - variation 2
pois.note: uv point is old-map water; snapped to the nearest walkable tile (old Jc dirt corridor)

pois.name: Tidebound coves & cairns - variation 3
pois.note: end of the south road at the SW cove

caveats: Old rows 16-111 of the coast are reconstructed from the older live3.js generator; Sand/Sand2 noise is approximate, so tiles_full_estimate is an estimate. The recipe only writes over old tiles in rows 0-19 (rows 0-15 = verified dump; rows 16-19 only the Water strip x0-7 that Xc paints).
The coast border layout (layout_coast_v2.json) is fitted to the 42x112 edge; see PROMPT_WP1 step for how to treat it.
